institution: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)
education: Undergraduate in Computer Science and Engineering
interests: Long-term memory in AI agents, continual learning, and skill reuse in robot learning.

projects.title: Nano-MemGPT | Diagnosing Small-Model Memory Failures
cv: Ran a 500-question memory-retrieval benchmark and used 398 judge-approved teacher traces to separate tool-call, retrieval, and answer-generation failures.
Trained rank-8 and rank-16 LoRA adapters for Llama-3-8B; compared teacher query hints with direct replay of retrieved evidence.

projects.title: Continual Learning for Robot Manipulation
cv: Gathered sequential SmolVLA baselines in LIBERO and helped design a team study of forgetting and replay in simulation and on an SO-101 robot arm.
Proposed DeMux/Mux, a parameter-reuse approach that adds capacity when existing components are insufficient.

projects.title: SkillCL | Compressed Replay for SmolVLA
cv: Prototyped replay from compressed vision-language features instead of raw observations and identified accumulating reconstruction error in preliminary sequential experiments.

projects.title: Maestro | Mobile Knowledge Tracing
projects.role: Team lead · Model design and Android deployment
cv: Designed and deployed MobileKT for tracking concept mastery. The team’s Android prototype bundled 1.48 MB of ONNX models and measured a 49 ms median latency per full step on a Galaxy Tab S8.

projects.title: Edge AI Video Processing
cv: Developed a C++ RTSP video pipeline with asynchronous object detection and recording on RK3588 and DEEPX DX-M1; worked on model conversion and inference validation.
